updates.text: A revised audit report shows that AeroMove Freight achieved a safety score of 84 points.

policies.text: A regional transit hub receives eco-transit funding if it achieves an annual carbon reduction of 15 percent.

Priority dispatch rights are granted to any carrier that satisfies a baseline fleet count of 15 planes, maintains a quarterly punctuality rate of 95 percent or higher, earns an evaluation rating of at least 90 points, and possesses valid cargo handling accreditation, or alternatively maintains an aviation master permit.
Transoceanic shipping clearance is assigned to any freight line providing a fleet cargo volume of 10000 TEU or greater.
Hazardous freight warehouse authorization requires a facility containment rating of 85 points.
Global tour operator accreditation is conferred upon an agency possessing a recognized tour provider certificate.
Awarding of sensitive government shipment orders requires that a logistics vendor holds priority dispatch rights.
